component.name: EpisodeItem
component.script:
sub init() m.border = m.top.findNode("focusBorder") m.fallback = m.top.findNode("fallback") m.thumbnail = m.top.findNode("thumbnail") m.scrim = m.top.findNode("imageScrim") m.number = m.top.findNode("episodeNumber") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFocusChanged") end sub
sub onContentChanged() item = m.top.itemContent if item = invalid then return m.title.text = item.title m.thumbnail.uri = item.hdPosterUrl episodeNum = item.getField("episodeNum") if episodeNum <> invalid m.number.text = "EPISODE " + episodeNum.toStr() else m.number.text = "EPISODE" end if updateLayout() end sub
sub onFocusChanged() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.border.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.top.scale = [1.025, 1.025] else m.border.color = "0x00000000" m.title.color = "0xE3E6EBFF" m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0] end if end sub
sub updateLayout() if m.top.width <= 0 or m.top.height <= 0 then return w = m.top.width h = m.top.height imageHeight = h - 58 m.border.width = w m.border.height = h m.fallback.translation = [4, 4] m.fallback.width = w - 8 m.fallback.height = imageHeight - 4 m.thumbnail.translation = [4, 4] m.thumbnail.width = w - 8 m.thumbnail.height = imageHeight - 4 m.scrim.translation = [4, imageHeight - 43] m.scrim.width = w - 8 m.scrim.height = 43 m.number.translation = [14, imageHeight - 36] m.number.width = w - 32 m.number.height = 32 m.title.translation = [10, imageHeight + 6] m.title.width = w - 20 m.title.height = 48 end sub
